capabilities: Edit a note's headings and bullet lists as a mind map with mind map, timeline, hierarchy and balanced layouts
Write node additions, edits, moves and colors back into the note's Markdown and frontmatter
Embed read-only maps in other notes via ![[...]] and show them on Canvas file cards
Insert maps into Excalidraw drawings or export the current map as SVG or PNG
Color nodes with highlighter colors stored as <mark> inline styles
extras: 0.x beta checked only on macOS desktop; desktop only, not loaded on mobile; no accounts, payments, servers or telemetry; README warns to back up the vault before everyday use and documents storage, backup and recovery behavior in detail.
problem: Obsidian has no way to read and edit a plain Markdown note as a mind map without moving the content into a separate format or file.

relations.evidence: With the Excalidraw plugin enabled, there are three ways.
In Markdown the node's text is wrapped in <mark style="background: …;">, as the Highlightr plugin writes it

summary: Mind map editor that shows a note's H2 headings and bullet lists as a linked map in four layouts and writes edits back to the note's Markdown.
